info.synopsis: Ultimamente sta succedendo qualcosa di strano, e molti viaggiatori sono stati attaccati e uccisi da mostri e orchi. Per caso incontrano una maga, si aiuteranno a vicenda e formeranno le basi per un party che col passare del tempo diverrà  più vasto e vario.

episodes.title: Why Do You Wield That Sword?
episodes.synopsis: Roan and Yuufa enter Rune-Midgaard's capital on the beginning of their adventures.  After doing a bit of shopping, they wonder around the city and get lost.  In a back alley they stumble across three ruffians accosting a lady mage.  They help the mage and scare the ruffians away.  The mage, Takius by name, sits down to eat with Roan and Yuufa and while there, they discuss the growing evil in the land.  The three ruffians summon a powerful monster, called The Clocktower Manager, to get revenge for their defeat earlier.

episodes.title: Be Good to Me, Big Brother
episodes.synopsis:
Upon discovering that the water is his room doesn't seem to be working, Roan decides to go out and buy breakfast.  While on his way back to the inn where they are staying, he over hears some men talking about a Golden Thief Bug in the sewers, which must explain why his water isn't working.
Roan heads back to the inn and convinces Yuufa that they are ready to head into the sewers to confront and kill this Golden Thief Bug.  After encountering and defeating some minor monsters, they see a small pink poring, which they follow and discover a girl in danger.  They rescue her and she introduces herself as Ma-Chan.  She is a collector of valuable items.
Ma-Chan follows Roan and Yuufa (much to Roan's dismay) and because of her annoying chatter, Roan yells at her to shut up.  She runs off and a few minutes later comes running back, followed by The Golden Thief Bug.

episodes.title: I Believe
episodes.synopsis: The group reached Geffern to hear news that ghost wanders inside Geffern Tower and so far no one has ever come out uninjured. Thanks to Maya's words, they decides to enter Geffern Tower with the help of Takius. But Takius doesn't seems to trust Maya at all.

episodes.title: Is That the Best You Can Do?
episodes.synopsis: The group decides to head back inside the tower where suddenly, Roan and the girls were seperated and get attacked by a strong moster each. Luckily, Iruga and Judia saves them and joins their party.

episodes.title: What Did You Say?
episodes.synopsis: The group intends to head back towards Prontera until they've faced a gigantic monster named Bahopment. Meanwhile Yuufa was shocked to hear about Keough from Judia.

episodes.title: I Won`t Let Anyone Get in My Way!
episodes.synopsis: Yuufa was getting suspicious of Keough alive so she decides to heard to the forest in search for his brother.

episodes.title: Will You Comfort Me?!?
episodes.synopsis: The group heads to Alberta to fight with the monsters inside but it turns out to be a false alarm since the monsters are 'pet monsters'. Meanwhile, Maya befreind with a human monster named Alice after saving her from Anasan and her two minions. But Takius sees it and hurt her feelings and make her go to Alice in tears. The next day, Ansan wants revenge and intend to kill Alice.

episodes.title: Life Is Precious
episodes.synopsis: The group were supposed to head towards Morroc Desert but gets lost in Payon Forest thanks to Judia's over-confidents. She later tells how she first met Iruga.

episodes.title: All for the Truth
episodes.synopsis: The Group head towards Morroc when they stumble at Ant Hell. They enter and sees lots of ants and were even happy to see the Queen. But at night, Takius makes a horrible mistake by killing the Queen's eggs and makes the monsters in Ant Hell go on a rampage.

episodes.title: You`re My Brother, Aren`t You?!?
episodes.synopsis: At Morroc, Maya suggest kicking Takius out of the group for her actions in Morroc but they still need her. On the other hand, a they want her help to enter the pyramids and defeat the monsters inside. They were more interested when they heard Keough was involved too.

episodes.title: All Is Only Despair
episodes.synopsis: Now monsters and the undead appear in Morroc and it's up to them to stop the source of the problem, Anubis, for creating chaos.

episodes.title: I Can`t Do It
episodes.synopsis: The gang have a rest in Morroc while Roan keeps practises by killing some monster in the desert. But after seeing Yufa hugs Iruga , this makes some misunderstanding and leaves the group. Meanwhile, Maya and Judia have some plans for Iruga during the party at night. But soon, the leader heard new of Al De Baran Clock Tower was infested by monsters.

episodes.title: The Protector
episodes.synopsis: Roan is in Izulde trying to power up his sword when he met and team up with Anasan and her minions. They head to the island and gets items but Roan's madness scares them and nearly gets him killed. Luckily, a female Crusader saves Roan from a powerful monster and Roan begs her to teach him to become a Crusader like her.

episodes.title: Why Won`t You Answer?
episodes.synopsis: In Al De Baran, the gang were inside the tower and gets themselves seperated. Yufa met his brother in his normal attitude but wasn't enough to fool Iruga. He later tells in his evil state how he becomes evil and tries to kill them. Iruga was badly injured and intends to finish ihm off but a familiar face saves them.

episodes.title: Don`t Worry, I`m Here
episodes.synopsis: Yufa was surprised to see Roan who is now a Crusader. He managed to defeat Keough but he fled. The group managed to stop the tower but Iruga decided to stay in Al De Baran (as he's injured) while Judia stays with him.

episodes.title: I Can`t Save Anyone
episodes.synopsis: The group heads to Payon and notices Roan's behavior has changed. Yufa is getting worried about it and later decides to leave the party for awhile to become a priest. Meanwhile, lots of undeads appear in Payon and keep coming.

episodes.title: You Are Already Tainted
episodes.synopsis: The situation turns worse as more undead appear and they have to flee. Worse that all the archers ran out of arrows. Roan couldn't fight all of them but is saved by a red-haired archer and teaches him the right path-that power isn't everything-before he returns back to the party.

episodes.title: I`ve Known All Along
episodes.synopsis: Yufa came back as a Priest and tries to save them once they've finished the job but soon they find the source of the undeads appearing, Moonlight Cat. She intends to kill them but Yufa and the rest of the group even Roan manages to confort her. But Zephil, Takius Master burns the monster to death and now plotting to kill them. Luckily Iruga and Judia appears in time to save them. In the end,  everyone in the group pray the Moonlight Cat's graveyard while Takius leaves the party.

episodes.title: We`ll Always Be Together
episodes.synopsis: The group heads back to Alberta where they were greeted by an unfriendly monsters while Maya sees a monster-type Alice where she has to decide whether to kill it or spare it.

episodes.title: It`s Okay
episodes.synopsis: After reaching to another port, the group intends to head towards Comodo but unfortunately Maya is still in shocked and walks to another area. She then realize that Alice will be always with her. Meanwhile, Roan met Keough but more stronger but just before Roan manage to defeat him, Yufa came and shield him, making an escape for him.

episodes.title: I Need You
episodes.synopsis: On their way, the group has to go inside a cave to reach Comodo. But Roan gets split up with the group while the rest have to fight with Keough and his monsters. Roan then was taught and lead by a female Monk and shows him back to the group. In the end, Yufa ask him a question ""'What's their relationship?"". Roan answer "" We're childhood friends!""

episodes.title: Who`s the Lonely One?
episodes.synopsis: The group reached Comodo where they found Anasan and her minions were seduced by Dancers and Bards because they clame themselves to be the one whose gets their credit. Suddenly, as they were enjoying, they were attacked by monsters while Yufa gets split up only to find Keough.

episodes.title: Good Bye
episodes.synopsis: Roan manage to save the dancers and thank them for showing the pattern. Just then, the same female Moke appears. She later changes into a Archer from Payon and then a Crusader in Izulde and finally her true self as the Legendary  Witch. She test Roan with her sword and Roan passed. She later gives him the sword and ask him to remember what he've learn. After she teleport to another area, it turns out that Bahopment have an alliance with her. Roan learns his lesson but was too late as Yufa leaves the party with Keough.

episodes.title: Place of Reckoning
episodes.synopsis: Takius joins back the group as a Sage and later the group heads to Glass Helm. But after saving Anasan's gang from the monsters, 'Yufa'  teleports them to Glass Helm where Takius fights with her master while Iruga deals with Keough.

episodes.title: One Who Realizes His Mistake
episodes.synopsis: As Roan , Maya and Judia rushed in diffrent directions, Takius's master dies and dies with her student after regreting of his bad deeds. Meanwhile, Maya found the seven crystals while Judia found a new weapon. Roan found Yufa and gets a kiss but she kills him as she turns evil by the Dark Lord.

episodes.title: For the Sake of Our Future
episodes.synopsis: While Roan tells Yufa about his wrong and say sorry to Yufa, Iruga and Keough dies together. Yufa manages to snapped out and return to normal only to see Roan going to dies. She manages to revived him by a kiss and both battle out the Dark Lord with the help of the Takius's soul (in the wand), Judia and Maya. They manage to defeat the Dark Lord and manage to escaped seeing Glass Heim collapse. In the end, Roan and Yufa were engaged and prays for both Iruga anf KEogh's graveyard and gets a new party members,  a swordsman and an acolyte with Judia (and her baby) and Maya.

episodes.title: A Miraculous and Magical Reunion!
episodes.synopsis: Mirai è una giovane strega che aiuta le persone grazie alla magia, ma un giorno si trova davanti un orso mostruoso che ricorda gli avversari affrontati un tempo. Per affrontare la nuova minaccia, Mirai si riunisce alla sua amica Liko e insieme si trasformano nelle streghe leggendarie Precure.

episodes.title: Back to the Magic World!
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver respinto l'attacco del misterioso nemico chiamato Ire, le Precure Mirai e Liko trovano una bambina identica d'aspetto alla loro amica Kotoha e capiscono che deve esserci un qualche legame tra le due cose. A quel punto, Liko rivela che è venuta nel mondo umano su richiesta del preside della scuola di magia per indagare su una catastrofe che in futuro colpirà il Reame Magico.

episodes.title: The Magic of Time
episodes.synopsis: Mirai rivela al preside che Ire le è apparso in una visione proprio all'orario che aveva preannunciato e che il suo vero obiettivo è la piccola Hisui. Dato che Ire indossava abiti umani, Mirai e Liko tornano nel Reame Nonmagico per raccogliere indizi sul nuovo nemico che non tarderà a tornare all'attacco.

episodes.title: Hisui`s Secret
episodes.synopsis: Mirai e Liko continuano a cercare indizi su Ire, ma la giovane universitaria deve occuparsi anche delle richieste di aiuto che arrivano a Maho Girl e così si mette alla ricerca di un gatto smarrito insieme a Hisui che insiste per accompagnarla. Tuttavia, Ire non tarda ad arrivare e grazie al potere dei servitori di Deusmast riesce a mettere in difficoltà le Precure, finché Hisui non interviene.

episodes.title: The Passing Years
episodes.synopsis: Hii-chan continua a crescere rapidamente e Liko capisce che non può continuare a vivere con la famiglia di Mirai senza suscitare sospetti, così decide di trasferirsi insieme alla bambina in un appartamento per abitanti del Reame Magico. Però, quando scopre la cosa, Mirai cerca in ogni modo di trasferirsi insieme a loro dato che non vuole rimanere di nuovo da sola.

episodes.title: True Objective
episodes.synopsis: Mirai e Liko si preparano a fronteggiare Ire nel Reame Magico per proteggere la scuola di magia, ma il nemico compare davanti a loro nel mondo umano contraddicendo apparentemente la visione. Durante la battaglia, Hisui accorre in soccorso della amiche, ma questo è proprio ciò che desidera Ire che la cattura e sfrutta per i suoi piani.

episodes.title: The Guardian of Time
episodes.synopsis: Ire è riuscito a usare il potere di Hisui per far risorgere la cronobestia Chronosto, che in cambio ha realizzato il suo desiderio di vivere per sempre in un momento nel passato tramutando il ragazzo in pietra. Benché in questo modo Mirai e Liko abbiano ritrovato l'amica Kotoha, non riescono a fare a meno di essere tristi per la perdita della piccola Hisui che sembra scomparsa.

episodes.title: Kotoha and Hisui
episodes.synopsis: Mirai e Liko ricevono la visita di Chikurun che porta un messaggio del preside e della leggendaria regina delle fate, e rivela alle Precure che Hisui è ancora viva. Mentre le ragazze accompagnano la piccola ape in un giro turistico in città, Mirai riceve un messaggio da parte di Rena che le dice che la loro amica Sara è scomparsa, così la giovane universitaria si mette subito alla sua ricerca.

episodes.title: Various Worlds
episodes.synopsis: Le Precure vanno nel Reame Magico per informare il preside che Kotoha ha recuperato i suoi poteri ed è riuscita a trasformarsi in Cure Felice, ma una volta lì incontrano Yamoh, un fedele servitore di Dokuroxy che non può starsene in disparte mentre qualcuno abusa della magia oscura per scopi malvagi.

episodes.title: Chasing Time
episodes.synopsis: Chronosto ha trasformato tutti gli abitanti del Reame Magico in statue di pietra accumulando enorme potere e poi è scomparso. Per trovarlo, le Precure uniscono le forze con Yamoh e tornano nel Reame Nonmagico affidandosi alla magia oscura, ma nemmeno lì sembra esserci traccia del nemico.

episodes.title: Mirai`s Decision
episodes.synopsis: Le Precure hanno trovato Chronosto nascosto nel Mondo Interstiziale, ma la cronobestia ha raccolto un potere enorme da tutto il tempo che ha divorato ed è diventata gigantesca. Inizia così un'epica battaglia senza esclusione di colpi per evitare che il potente nemico imprigioni tutte le forme di vita nel passato.

episodes.title: The Proper Future
episodes.synopsis: Per liberarsi dalla prigionia di Chronosto, le Precure hanno deciso di sacrificare i propri ricordi e rinascere a nuova vita come ha fatto anche Kotoha in passato diventando Hisui, ma Mirai ha promesso alle sue amiche che si incontreranno di nuovo e riusciranno a ricordare chi erano, così da sconfiggere la cronobestia una volta per tutte.

info.title: I Colori Dell’Anima
info.synopsis: Totsuko, una liceale che frequenta la Christian Academy di Nagasaki, ha un potere davvero particolare: riesce a vedere i "colori" delle emozioni nel cuore delle persone. Per impedire ai suoi amici e alla sua famiglia di provare sentimenti oscuri, si preoccupa, legge le situazioni e arriva persino a mentire per appianare discussioni e litigi. Un giorno, in una libreria antiquaria, incontra una bella ragazza con emozioni di un colore incredibilmente vivace e un ragazzo amante della musica che cerca di mettere insieme un gruppo musicale. La storia segue queste tre persone particolarmente sensibili che si riuniscono con l'intento di formare una band.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis:
Earth, eight months after the end of the One Year War. Captain Monica launches a secret mission, "Operation Thunderbolt," and selects Io to pilot the Atlas Gundam. She leads the assault landing ship Spartan into a part of the ocean effectively controlled by the South Seas Alliance. Their objective is to secure or destroy the data of the Psycho Zaku, which the Alliance now possesses.

Daryl, who took the upper hand in his battle with Io, has descended to Earth as part of the remnant forces of the Principality of Zeon. He has also been given the mission of obtaining information on the Psycho Zaku.

Fighting alongside his new comrades, Io encounters Commander Peer, the South Seas Alliance's border garrison commander. In the sea, on the ice field, and among the thick jungle, the mobile suits of Zeon, the Federation, and the South Seas Alliance battle each other.

"The war is not over yet."

info.title: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie
info.synopsis: Marte, anno 2071. Alla vigilia di Halloween un gruppo di terroristi dirotta un camion sull'autostrada vicina ad Alba City, facendo fuoriuscire da esso un virus che uccide oltre 500 persone; tale virus è stato realizzato su Marte. Il governo, venuto a sapere dell'incidente, decide di stanziare 300 milioni di woolongs per chiunque riesca a catturare l'autore del micidiale progetto criminale. L'uomo si scoprirà poi essere Vincent Volaju, un veterano del conflitto avvenuto su Titano molti anni prima. La ciurma del Bebop decide di seguire il caso, ma il mistero dietro il virus è molto più complicato di quanto Spike Spiegel e compagni possano pensare: i pericoli che dovranno affrontare potrebbero rivelarsi davvero ingestibili.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: A tanker truck is blown to smithereens in the middle of a busy street, and a deadly viral infection is released with the explosion. The Bebop crew - Spike Spiegel, Jet Black, Faye Valentine, and Edward Wong Hau Pepelu Tivrusky IV - are instantly after the culprit when the gargantuan reward of 300,000,000 woolongs is announced. But the case gets stranger and stranger as the cold-blooded Vincent Volaju, who supposedly has been dead for ten years, seems to be the prime suspect. Meanwhile, Spike encounters the dangerous Electra, who too seeks the madman. Conspiracies and secrets better left alone are uncovered, and Vincent's reign of terror is nowhere near over yet...

info.title: Lamù - Beautiful Dreamer
info.synopsis: I preparativi per il festival scolastico al liceo Tomobiki proseguono spediti, il lavoro è talmente tanto che pare quasi non volere finire con studenti e professori che passano giorni e notti a scuola da un tempo che nessuno riesce a definire con precisione. L'unica persona perfettamente a suo agio in questa situazione è Lamù: felice di trascorrere 24 ore al giorno con Ataru e tutti i suoi amici, confessa a Shinobu che il suo sogno per il futuro è proprio questo. Le cose però si fanno sempre più strane fino a degenerare: i ragazzi non riescono più a tornare a casa, la scuola Tomobiki e tutti gli studenti si sentono isolati dal mondo con la sola casa Moroboshi disponibile.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: In this film, the students of Tomobiki High are not surprised to find the day repeating over and over again. And then things start getting really strange. Possibly the best loved of all the Urusei Yatsura movies, and certainly one of the most memorable.

info.title: Suki desu Suzuki-kun!!
info.synopsis: Una storia di intrecci amorosi che coinvolgono quattro compagni di classe, Sayaka, Hikaru, Chihiru e Shinobu.

info.title: Ultimate Girls
info.synopsis: Come ogni lunedì, Tokyo viene attaccata da un terrificante mostro gigante che è intento a seminare il panico per le vie cittadine. Silk, Vivian e Tsubomi attratte dall'apparizione decidono di avvicinarsi all'entità per poterla vedere da vicino, consce del fatto che la loro vita non è assolutamente in pericolo dato che a breve arriverà UFO-man, l'eroe che libera ogni volta Tokyo dalla minaccia aliena.

episodes.title: Ultimate Operation Number 1
episodes.synopsis: While looking for a better vantage point for viewing the monster attacking Tokyo, Silk, Vivienne, and Tsubomi get crushed by the giant hero UFO-Man as he comes to save the day. He resurrects them, but at the cost of being unable to fight the monsters himself. He gives Silk the power to transform into a giant heroine, but her costume only lasts a few short minutes before beginning to disappear. Silk saves the day by defeating her first monster.

episodes.title: Shine! The Ultimate Three Sisters
episodes.synopsis: Vivienne and Tsubomi learn that they, too, can transform into giant heroes, but with the same caveat as before. Tsubomi transforms and tries to fight the monster, but is quickly defeated. Vivienne transforms ad fights the alien, and Tsubomi's brother is captured by the attacking alien.

episodes.title: When UG dies, Tokyo collapses!
episodes.synopsis: The girls learn that their power comes from being embarrassed (because their costumes keep gradually disappearing until they are naked), and the more embarrassed they become, the stronger they become. Vivienne immobilizes the alien, but it breaks free. The girls learn that the core of the alien must be destroyed. Silk transforms and defeats the alien. Silk thinks Vivienne is mad at her and also has a crush on Makoto, Tsubomi's older brother.

episodes.title: Ah! It`s Eating Tsubomi!
episodes.synopsis: The local TV station has put out a reward for pictures identifying the Ultimate Girls. When the next monster attacks, Tsubomi goes to fight it, but appears to be defeated after posing for all the photographers. As her costume begins disappearing, she begins to act sick, thus tricking the monster into coming to help her. She then rips out its core and defeats it.

episodes.title: From Akiba With Love
episodes.synopsis: Silk and Vivienne are tricked into working with Tsubomi at her part time job: waitressing at a cosplay cafe while dressed (respectively) as Hazuki from Moon Phase and Sailor Moon from Pretty Soldier Sailor Moon. While Tsubomi is entertaining the customers, Silk and Vivienne go on break just as a new monster appears. Vivienne has trouble beating the monster until she sees Silk cheering her on. After the fight, Makoto tells Silk that he likes the Ultimate Girl who just won the battle, which causes Silk to become upset and run away.

episodes.title: Silk Gets Desperate
episodes.synopsis: The girls go to the beach, unaware that Silk's sister has set up an event there she is hoping to use to discover the true identities of the Ultimate Girls. Silk continues to misunderstand Vivienne's feelings for Makoto, and Makoto is hoping to snap a picture of an Ultimate Girl as she changes back to normal. After Silk defeats the monster, Vivienne explains that she's not in love with makoto, but that she has someone else.

episodes.title: Ultimate Girls, to the west
episodes.synopsis: Silk's class goes on a school trip, and she leave UFO-man behind in her room. On the way past Mount Fuji, a monster appears and puts everyone to sleep. UFO-man arrives and wakes up the girls. Silk fights the monster, but begins to lose when the monster begins tickling her. However, this also increases her power, and she defeats the monster, but not before everyone wakes up and the bus with her classmates drives away before she finishes the fight. As she's walking down the highway after the fight, Makoto stops and picks her up, giving her a ride to where the bus was going.

episodes.title: Onward to Kyoto
episodes.synopsis: The girls and their class arrive in Kyoto and enjoy an evening relaxing in an onsen after spending several hours learning Zen meditation. Vivienne takes the other girls out for a night on the town in order to cheer up Silk, who has learned that Makoto is going back to Tokyo early. A new monster appears and Tsubomi appears to defeat it after using her meditation techniques to lure it into an unguarded state. However, the monster was not defeated, and it escaped.

episodes.title: Vivienne, Dies in the Setting Sun
episodes.synopsis: The girls are still in Kyoto the morning after the monster escaped. Vivienne arranges for Silk and Makoto to be alone at an amusement park while she and Tsubomi go off somewhere else. While they are going around, Makoto confesses he likes "Little Boobs" the best of the three Ultimate Girls, which causes Silk to become very embarrassed. At that moment, the monster reappears within the amusement park. Even though she's feeling sick from riding a rollercoaster three times in a row, Vivienne fights and defeats the monster in order to allow Silk to continue her "date".

episodes.title: It`s UG! Sprout!
episodes.synopsis: It's Christmas time. After giving a present to Makoto at a party, Silk finds out he's going to the United States to study journalism. In order to try to cheer her up, Vivienne and Tsubomi take her to Comike, where Silk promptly gets separated from the other two girls just as a new monster appears. After defeating the monster, Silk admits to Makoto that she's one of the Ultimate Girls.

episodes.title: Pervert
episodes.synopsis: Makoto misunderstands Silk's confession, thinking she is only cosplaying, and he asks if he can tak her picture when she's in costume. Tsubomi takes the opportunity to get the other girls to cosplay with her as the Ultimate Girls. Makoto finds out that Okamura is a dōjinshi collector who has collected a very large number of Ultimate Girl books and has a table reserved for the final day of Comike to sell a book of his own. Makoto is inspired by him and decided to become the ultimate Ultimate Girls collector. Suddenly, a new monster appears and defeats Tsubomi in one punch, but not before she notices that her brother, Makoto, is the core of the monster. Vivienne goes to fight the monster, but starts losing to it, too. Tsubomi tells Silk that the monster is her brother.

episodes.title: Farewell Ultimate Girl
episodes.synopsis: Vivienne is defeated, with the monster demanding to know who they really are. UFO-man explains how the monsters come into existence and states that there isn't a way to save Makoto as he is directly connected to the core of the monster. Silk offers to give up her body so that Makoto can live once the monster is defeated, and asks UFO-man to erase any memory of her from Makoto. She then goes to fight the monster, which she defeats after destroying its core. However, she hesitated before destroying it, and didn't hurt Makoto very much, so UFO-man used his power to repair Makoto instead. Makoto decides to not go to America after all, and gives her a picture he took of her while she was transformed.

info.title: La città delle bestie ammaliatrici
info.synopsis: Per millenni tra la razza umana e quella dei demoni appartenenti al Lato Oscuro c'è uno scontro segreto, di cui le persone normali non sono a conoscenza. Nel corso della storia dell'umanità ci sono stati molti contatti con il Lato Oscuro. Gli Illuminati del nostro mondo e dell'altro hanno sempre cercato di armonizzare fra loro, scambiandosi idee e conoscenze, imparando a vivere in pace. Ma c'erano altre persone che, per interesse, volevano tenere i due mondi separati e in guerra. A causa loro ci furono anni di genocidi e distruzioni. Alla fine gli Illuminati aumentarono il loro potere in entrambi i mondi, finché fu stipulato un patto di non aggressione. Questo accadeva molti secoli fa e l'ultimo trattato è stato violato parecchie volte ma, alla fine del ventesimo secolo sta per essere stipulato un nuovo trattato di pace. Però alcuni membri del Lato Oscuro non desiderano che venga rinnovato. Per firmare un nuovo trattato viene richiamato dall'Italia il dottor Giuseppe Maiato, il più importante ambasciatore della razza umana, la cui presenza è fondamentale per la firma del trattato. Come guardie del corpo di questo importante personaggio vengono scelti l'umano Renzaburo Taki e la bellissima Makie, appartenente alla razza del Lato Oscuro. Ma non tutto è come sembra e dietro al rinnovo del trattato c'è un piano secolare con lo scopo finale di far integrare le due razze.

info.title: Pretty Cure All Stars DX – Il film 2: Luce della speranza ☆ Proteggi il Rainbow Jewel!
info.synopsis: Tsubomi e Erika ricevono una lettera da parte di Chypre e Coffret in cui vengono invitate a visitare il Fairy Park, un parco di divertimenti che sorge una volta ogni mille anni, in cui appare la mistica gemma Rainbow Jewel. Arrivate sul posto, le ragazze incontrano Love, Miki, Inori e Setsuna, che chiedono loro di aiutarle a cercare le altre amiche all’interno del parco. Improvvisamente vengono attaccate da Uraganos, Kintresky, Mucardia e Northa, che rivelano che il Rainbow Jewel è preso di mira da Bottom, un’entità malvagia che vuole impossessarsi del suo potere per avvolgere il mondo nell’oscurità e nell’infelicità..

info.title: Digimon Beatbreak
info.synopsis: L'e-Pulse, generato dai pensieri e dalle emozioni umane, veniva utilizzato come fonte di energia per il dispositivo di supporto AI chiamato "Sapotama". Ma dalle ombre di questo straordinario sviluppo emersero mostri terrificanti. I Digimon sono esseri viventi che evolvono consumando e-Pulse. Tomorou Tenma viene trascinato in un'esperienza straordinaria dopo l'incontro con Gekkomon, comparso improvvisamente dal suo Sapotama. Vivendo insieme a Kyou Sawashiro e agli altri membri della squadra di cacciatori di taglie "Golden Dawn", Tomorou rinnova la sua determinazione. Quale nuovo futuro sarà forgiato da esseri umani e Digimon?

episodes.title: The Beat of Emotions
episodes.synopsis: An ideal society managed by Sapotamas. Underneath, terrifying creatures called Digimon appear. After a classmate is attacked, Tomoro Tenma's emotions explode. Suddenly his Sapotama shines and Gekkomon is born.

episodes.title: Glowing Dawn
episodes.synopsis: Gekkomon is awakened by Tomoro's anger and overwhelms his enemy. Just then, a mysterious Digimon steals their Sapotama. With his brother lost, Tomoro shuts down emotionally, until he is shocked by what the leader of the "Glowing Dawn" has to say.

episodes.title: Facing Mirrors
episodes.synopsis: Upon learning that the bounty intel is wrong, Tomoro and Gekkomon follow the scent of his own e-Pulse. There they find the Mirror World, a virtual space inside the net. Inside the Sapotama that glows within Hyemon…

episodes.title: Family
episodes.synopsis: Reina is in high spirits after being handed leadership for the next job by Kyo. But, because of Tomoro's mistake, the Machmon bounty escapes. Rookie member Tomoro can't understand Reina's obsession with the Glowing Dawn being a family.

episodes.title: Half and Half
episodes.synopsis: Tomoro wanders into an old shopping district where he witnesses the Panda-gumi protecting the town from thugs. Their leader Sasatake and Pandamon have a bond of father and child. Meanwhile, Yuukari of the Koala-kai prepares to evict the residents.

episodes.title: The Bond of Parent and Child
episodes.synopsis: Pandamon is furious that Yuukari has hurt the boss but is conflicted between their feelings and teachings about chivalry. Tomoro wants to challenge Astamon in battle. Meanwhile, Kyo investigates the identity of the mastermind.

episodes.title: Nirinso
episodes.synopsis: Tomoro and the others find hikers who’ve nearly fallen victim to Cold Heart. They are saved by an exhausted Kyo and Murasamemon. Deep in the mountain is an old observatory that holds Kyo’s secret.

episodes.title: The Vanishing Classroom
episodes.synopsis: Hitomi takes Tomoro to school to investigate a series of student disappearances. Only the top students are going missing. Gekkomon struggles to rescue Tomoro when he’s trapped inside Mimicmon.

episodes.title: Utopia
episodes.synopsis: Going after a bounty, the Glowing Dawn infiltrate Shangri-La Egg, a utopia created after a massive disaster. There, other Cleaners who are also after Goldnumemon appear in front of Tomoro and the others…

episodes.title: A True Friend
episodes.synopsis: Chiropmon is taken from Makoto by Haruko, who sees Digimon as toys. Kyo tries to interrupt the buyer’s transaction, while Makoto feels troubled because his own weakness caused Chiropmon to suffer.

episodes.title: A Black Emotion
episodes.synopsis: While out buying a birthday present for Asuka, Tomoro gets into a fight with Gekkomon over picking a scarf. Separated from Tomoro, the sulking Gekkomon encounters a Digimon who emits poisonous gas.

episodes.title: A New Family
episodes.synopsis: Tomoro regrets that Kyo and Gekkomon got hurt because of him and faces his job as a Cleaner once more. Meanwhile, a Digimon with an abnormal e-Pulse heads towards the Glowing Dawn's headquarters.

episodes.title: Five Star Meeting
episodes.synopsis: The Five Stars, who stand at the top of the Cleaner world, gather for a meeting. The topic is the increase in Cold Heart incidents and emerging disaster-class Digimon. Meanwhile, Tomoro and the others encounter a strange trio at a crime site.

episodes.title: Tactics
episodes.synopsis: The Tactics are Cleaner teams that undergo rigorous training to perfect e-Pulse control. The Glowing Dawn members face off against them over a bounty, but Tomoro can't accept their methods.

episodes.title: Little Courage
episodes.synopsis: The Kinoko Gang, holding a grudge, sneak into Nirinso while Kyo is away, aiming to destroy the Glowing Dawn. Redvegimon paralyzes Gekkomon and the others, while the In-Training Digimon can only watch…

episodes.title: Where I Belong
episodes.synopsis: Granit’s interference causes Reina to let her target escape, and they are both taken to a cold, snowy mountain by Moosemon. While they look for clues to go back, Granit recalls the birth of Ludomon.

episodes.title: Antipathy
episodes.synopsis: While pursuing a Koemon, the Glowing Dawn encounter the Tactics. Hotaruko's siblings mistake Makoto for her coworker and invite them for okonomiyaki. Hotaruko becomes hostile towards them, but there's an issue of food theft in town…

episodes.title: The Price of Freedom
episodes.synopsis: Tomoro and the others treat a man who collapsed outside their headquarters to stew, but then the Tactics demand they hand him over. While they try to stop the Tactics, Commandramon is taken away. The man shares his dark past.

episodes.title: Black Market Auction
episodes.synopsis: Tomoro and the others infiltrate an illegal Digimon auction held by Five Star member Klay Arslan. While investigating the venue which is being guarded by Tactics, they find a girl and her Tinkermon locked in a cage.

episodes.title: Proof of Genius
episodes.synopsis: Tomoro gets kidnapped by a monkey Digimon and wakes up in an arena inside the Mirror World, where Digimon Owners are forced to fight. After Tomoro wins his first match, his next opponent appears to be Raito.

episodes.title: The One Beside You
episodes.synopsis: The members of Glowing Dawn rush to Tomoro’s aid. Tomoro descends beneath the colosseum to rescue Raito who was taken away. Naito and his team intercept Kyo, but Reina suddenly notices something wrong with Granit…

episodes.title: Defiance
episodes.synopsis: Naito relentlessly pursues Kyo in order to fulfill Clay's wish. Meanwhile, Hotaruko is tormented by the order to eliminate the traitor. At that moment, Honoka of the Abyss, the Water Star and one of the Five Elements Stars, appears and declares that she has come to hunt Tactics.

episodes.title: The Power to Take
episodes.synopsis: Tomorow and his friends head to the Coliseum to rescue those who have been frozen. Meanwhile, Kray is steadily making preparations to fulfill his own ambitions. Kyo and Murasamemon confront Proganomon, who is enveloped in a mysterious light...

episodes.title: Overlapping Beats
episodes.synopsis: To save Kyo, Tomorou fights Clay. Helpless against Clay's overwhelming power, his family is injured. Consumed by rage, Tomorou goes berserk, when the genius he once defeated appears before him.

episodes.title: Half-Baked Hero
episodes.synopsis: On their way back to their hideout, Tomorou and his friends spend a brief vacation on a luxury cruise ship and encounter Handa, a popular showman, and Starmon. To Makoto and Kiropmon, he is the legendary Cleaner. Starmon takes on pirates who attack the luxury cruise ship, but...

episodes.title: The Taste of Guilt
episodes.synopsis: Haruomi was found collapsed in front of a Nirinsou flower. He was rescued by Kyo and reunited with Commandramon, but also encountered a weakened Elizamon. The two, vying for Haruomi's partner, are set up to settle their rivalry with a cooking battle, as suggested by Geckomon.

episodes.title: Wandering Love
episodes.synopsis: Hitomi is reunited with Tomorou after a long time, but something seems off. A strange bandage wrapped around Hitomi causes Tomorou and the others to start showing affection towards the Digimon. Geckomon and the others run away and beg Maki for help...

episodes.title: Gift
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou visits Asuka in the hospital and encounters a mysterious girl. Meanwhile, Growing Dawn also heads to the hospital to catch a serial killer. There, he encounters a supporter who is obsessed with Digimon and a Digimon with an abnormal obsession with deliveries.

episodes.title: Dangerous Fandom
episodes.synopsis: In order to investigate the Digimon incident, Rena infiltrates a fan meeting for young actor Urato. There, she encounters Rose, a beauty evangelist and one of the Five Elements Stars. Rena is bewildered by the unfamiliar surroundings, but then Urato approaches her, revealing his true identity...

episodes.title: Wings to Protect You
episodes.synopsis: Growing Dawn visits Shangri-La Egg again at the request of the president of Kuonji Industries. Makoto and Kiropmon's expressions are clouded as they listen to the testimony of Tsukasa, the twin brother who is hospitalized. As they continue their investigation, the true motive of the culprit becomes clear.

episodes.title: One Step Forward
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou encounters a reclusive girl on the beach who is accompanied by a Digimon. Maki explains to Tomorou and his friends that there is an urgent matter: a very dangerous Digimon has appeared in the bay area. At that moment, two Cleaners appear and approach the girl.

episodes.title: Cold Rain
episodes.synopsis: Following the GIFT incident, informants were being killed one after another. Tomorou and his friends, along with their next target Maki, flee the Garando. Maki had a plan to settle the score with the opposing Digimon...

episodes.title: Midsummer Ghost
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou and his friends visit a beach house run by Hotaruko. While enjoying the local specialty, grilled mantis shrimp, they discover Light and Monodramon lying unconscious at the water's edge. Light leaves indifferently, but a dark shadow watches them.

episodes.title: Behind the Mask
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou devises a plan and catches the serial kidnapper. The next day, while he is on the hospital rooftop with Asuka, Miharu appears. Sensing her strange presence, he inadvertently starts reminiscing about his memories with Asuka, when they receive news that the kidnapper has been released...

episodes.title: Rampaging Instinct
episodes.synopsis: Lena trains hard with Pristimon to get revenge on Rose. Meanwhile, a series of bombings targeting World Union-related facilities by GIFT occurs. Feeling anxious and losing focus, Lena lets the target escape and becomes discouraged.

episodes.title: Twisted Code
episodes.synopsis: GIFT, having attacked Chairman Wang, begins a countdown to the entire world for the sake of its true objective. Meanwhile, guided by sapotama, Tomorou meets Miharu in the Mirror World. Amidst the battle, Mephismon emerges from the dark clouds swirling in the background.

episodes.title: Kind Magic
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou, Rose, and the others storm the temple that serves as GIFT's headquarters. Having seized control of the Shangri-La Egg system, Miharu takes the residents hostage and demands that Chairman O reveal the existence of Digimon to the public. When Tomorou questions her, Miharu begins to speak of her older sister Chifuyu's wish, but...

episodes.title: Hollow Thirst
episodes.synopsis: Tomoro Tenma and his Digimon Gekkomon join the bounty hunters Golden Dawn to investigate rogue Digimon.

episodes.title: Lip Service
episodes.synopsis: Meto and Kanon attack the Glowing Dawn, looking for Kyo Sawashiro. Meanwhile, at Nirinso, Souji Kuroshio attempts to quench his thirst by threatening to destroy everything Kyo treasures, demanding Kyo return to his old self.

episodes.title: Unfading Night
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou is shocked to learn the true identity of former Five-Star Planet member Kuroshio Soji from Clay, yet he renews his resolve to bring Kyo back. Meanwhile, as Kyo heads to the showdown to settle things once and for all, he finds himself reminiscing about the days he once spent at the observatory.

episodes.title: A Golden Tomorrow
episodes.synopsis: At the site of the decisive battle, Tomorou and the others found themselves struggling against three Perfect-level opponents. Finally steeling his resolve, Kyo overwhelmed Soji. Tomorou attempted to stop Kyo by invoking the sole rule of Growing Dawn, but...

episodes.title: Sakura Friendship
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou took Kyo—who wanted to see Asuka after a long time—to visit her in the hospital. On the way, Kyo began sharing memories of Asuka that even Tomorou didn't know about. Hidden within those stories lay the secret behind the birth of Koogamon.

episodes.title: The White Digimon
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou is bewildered by the sudden appearance of Asuka and her partner Digimon. Meanwhile, Kishiwada arrives at Apraxas, having been appointed as the new "Five-Star" representative for the Planet of Earth. What is the final piece needed for the Shangri-La Project...?

episodes.title: The Strongest Man
episodes.synopsis: As Kyo and the others raced to rescue Tomorou, Kaito appeared, intent on settling the score. Separated from the group, Rena found herself facing Honoka, while Makoto confronted Kishiwada. Amidst a violent pulsing of energy, Flaremon was enveloped in light, and Kaito—driven by the pursuit of ultimate strength—wore a fearless grin...

episodes.title: Big Brother, Little Brother
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou resolves to bring back Asuka, who has lost her will. He and his "Family" confront Heliosboamon, but Kaneda and Gokumon suddenly barge into the fray. While Tomorou is forced onto the defensive, what is the true objective Kaneda reveals?

episodes.title: Glitch
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou, having awakened thanks to the Nirinsou, wore a look of deep anguish. Meanwhile, Chairman O declared that he would eliminate the "bugs" known as Digimon and deliver an ideal world. Just then, a new member of the Five Planetary Stars launched an attack on the Nirinsou.

episodes.title: The Ultimate Power
episodes.synopsis: Growing Dawn charges into Aproxas to rescue Asuka. With the help of their allies, they arrive at their destination, only to find Chairman King and Kaneda standing in Tomorou's path. Meanwhile, Monarchlizamon engages in a fierce clash with his sworn rival, Gokuwmon, but...

episodes.title: Two Beats
episodes.synopsis: Sanzomon finally reveals her true form and begins absorbing e-pulses from the people to realize a utopia for Digimon. With their resolve renewed, Tomorow and his friends confront Seitengokumon to rescue Geckomon and Asuka...

episodes.title: A World of Shining Light
episodes.synopsis: Tomorou Tenma and Asuka Tenma face their final battle for the sake of a new future shared by humans and Digimon. However, they find themselves in a desperate situation when confronted by the overwhelming power of Seitengokumon. Just then, the Atlatusmon Sapotama emits a brilliant, intense light.

info.title: Ichigo Aika: Strawberry Elegy
info.synopsis: Dopo le seconde nozze del padre, Kōta si ritrova a convivere con una nuova sorellastra, Aika. All'apparenza è una gyaru educata e rispettosa con i genitori, ma lontano dai loro occhi rivela un carattere vivace, impertinente e provocatorio. La convivenza all'inizio è difficile e il ragazzo fatica a tollerare i suoi atteggiamenti, che gli rendono la vita complicata. Con il passare del tempo, però, dietro la maschera ribelle emergono lati più autentici e affettuosi, e il rapporto tra i due prende una direzione inaspettata.

episodes.title: A Pair of Really Crappy Siblings!
episodes.synopsis: Aika, the new younger sister of Kota Takamura from his father's remarriage, is a super sassy gal who bluntly calls her stepbrother “lame” upon first meet. Calling each other names, with each holding the worst impression of the other, they begin living under the same roof. But Aika would bring men into her room and get down to business whenever the parents were out. Kota is greatly troubled by her loud and clear moans, but then one day, something changes...

episodes.title: The Hell Are You?!
episodes.synopsis: That day, Aika was indulging in intimacy with her boyfriend Takahashi in her room as usual. However, a certain situation stirs trouble between them. To make matters worse for Aika, Kota, who had heard the commotion, shows up at the door. Aika tries to brush him off and send him away, but Kota makes a bold move that takes them both by surprise.

episodes.title: A Secret From Mom
episodes.synopsis: Despite Aika skipping school and bringing boys home—behavior that could be called delinquent—she hides it from her parents and acts like a model daughter... Living together, Kota witnesses her dual nature firsthand. One day, Kota accidentally runs into Aika in the bathroom right after she's had a shower. Wondering which is the real Aika, he plucks up the courage to ask her directly...

episodes.title: A Ready-Made Duo
episodes.synopsis: That night after the incident in the bathroom, Aika and Kota each lay in their own rooms, lost in thoughts of the other. Aika replays Kota's words and actions in her mind, sensing something different from the guys she'd dated before—guys who were only after her body. Late at night, Kota goes to the kitchen to prepare instant noodles for a late-night snack. Then, Aika comes over...

episodes.title: Aika's Close Call!
episodes.synopsis: Aika still lets Takahashi into her room, although today she seems unusually reluctant. The tactless Takahashi doesn't seem to care however, teasing that all guys get horny around the sexy Aika. Aika snaps and slaps him across the face. Takahashi then changes his tune, trying to force himself on her...

episodes.title: Just Hold Me Tight, Dammit
episodes.synopsis: Kota narrowly defeats Takahashi and succeeds in protecting Aika. But now, with Aika still in her disheveled state, she asks him to hold her tight, leaving him flustered. Out of a sense of responsibility as her older brother, Kota tells her to put her clothes back on properly. However, after she had tidied herself, Aika demands he embrace her once more. Kota found himself cornered, with nowhere to escape.

episodes.title: Breaking Down is a Bad Idea!
episodes.synopsis: From hugging to touching of the lips— Just when they were about to cross the line, Misaki comes home, leaving Aika and Kota unfinished. Just when that seemed to be the end of it, the next day, when their parents had gone out and they were alone together, Aika makes her move and asks if they can finish off from yesterday. Overwhelmed by Aika's bold approach, Kota almost goes with the flow again...

episodes.title: Why Don't You Take It Like A Man
episodes.synopsis: The Takamura family heads to Atami for a trip! While his parents enjoy some couple time alone, Kota explores the sights by himself, making the most of the trip. Later, as he rests back at the inn, Aika returns to the room in her yukata after bathing. Kota can't help but be captivated by Aika's different, more traditional Japanese-style vibe—a change from her usual self. But Aika is quick to sense his gaze...

episodes.title: My Fave Kind of Guy!
episodes.synopsis: The Takamura family's Atami trip continues! Aika and Kota arrive at the beach. While Aika, in her swimsuit, is strolling alone, she gets hit on by a guy. Though inwardly fed up, Aika decides to play it cool to avoid trouble. She tries to brush him off, casually dropping that her friend's here and makes her escape. But the unexpectedly clueless guy doesn't get the hint, and forcefully grabs Aika's hand, plunging her into an unexpected predicament.

episodes.title: Here Like Normal
episodes.synopsis: Now it's become perfectly normal for Aika to read manga in Kouta's room. She brings all the volumes out to read them all at once in the living room, but the moment she sees the dark hallway, she becomes strange and dejected, returning to Kouta's room. Aika confesses to Kouta that she's scared of being alone. Kouta assumes she just hates being on her own, but it seems there was more to it than that...

episodes.title: Kinda Bad-Boy, Don'tcha Think?
episodes.synopsis: Aika realizes she feels both excited and satisfied from her physical closeness with Kouta. Then at that moment, the image of a certain guy who once boasted that he'll teach her what real love is, flashes through her mind... Kouta, having finished his part-time job, was about to head home when he coincidentally runs into Aika, who was visiting as a customer. They end up going home together, but Aika leads him to a certain place.

episodes.title: From Teary To Twinkly
episodes.synopsis: Aika boldly barges in on Kouta's bath time, holding a trendy bath bomb. Meanwhile, Kouta, concerned by Aika's tears he saw in the ruins, blurts out something that spoils the mood. However, Aika's reaction was different from what Kouta had expected. Sensing something, Kouta asks Aika to tell him about herself. Then, Aika begins to recount a certain event from her past.

info.title: Baki-dou: The Invincible Samurai
info.synopsis: Baki è annoiato. Dopo la conclusione della battaglia epica tra padre e figlio, lui continua a fare combattimenti underground e ad allenarsi senza fermarsi, ma deve sempre reprimere il suo sbadiglio causato dalla noia. Nessuno stimolo o pericolo può portare eccitazione in lui in questo momento. Ora, con l'inclusione del Primo Ministro Giapponese nel circuito, un grande progetto di clonazione di massa sta provando a clonare Miyamoto Musashi, uno dei padri delle arti marziali in Giappone. Un'altra battaglia di proporzioni epiche attende Baki!

episodes.title: Practical Fighter

info.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
info.synopsis: Sasaki è un impiegato di 45 anni intrappolato nella monotonia del lavoro e della vita quotidiana. L'unico momento di sollievo nella sua routine è la breve visita serale a un supermercato, dove la gentilezza e il sorriso della giovane cassiera Yamada riescono, anche solo per un attimo, a fargli dimenticare lo stress. Una sera, però, Yamada ha già finito il turno e l'uomo, deluso, si rifugia dietro il negozio per fumare. Lì incontra Tayama: una donna misteriosa, schietta e diretta, molto diversa dalla dolce Yamada... eppure, qualcosa in lei gli sembra stranamente familiare. Tra una sigaretta e l’altra, Sasaki scopre in Tayama una nuova compagna di silenzi e parole non dette. E così, tra i corridoi illuminati del supermercato e l’ombra tranquilla dell’area fumatori, la sua vita inizia lentamente a cambiare...

episodes.title: Family Restaurant Meeting With Dad
episodes.synopsis: The series of incidents involving the former Yozakura heads turn out to part of Momo's plot to resurrect his beloved wife, Rei. As he whispers about his twisted love for his family, Momo vanishes from Mutsumi and the others' sight. Meanwhile, Kyoichiro, who was saved by Taiyo's Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers, returns home to his siblings. The touching reunion is short-lived, as in order to make him reflect after trying to sacrifice himself to protect the family, a "Day of Family Service" begins! What lies in store for Kyoichiro is his siblings' merciless requests... Just then, a message arrives for Mutsumi.

episodes.title: The Gold Rank Spy Meeting
episodes.synopsis: Under Mutsumi's orders, Kyoichiro and Taiyo pursue the fleeing Momo. Taiyo manages to land a punch on Momo once, but the gap in abilities between himself and Momo, who can hold his own against Kyoichiro, is all too clear, and he's left on the defensive. On top of that, numerous Dark Cherries - creatures birthed by Tsubomi, which feed on humans as nutrients - appear, blocking the way. Taiyo launches another attack, but he falls just short, letting Momo get away. Kyoichiro destroys the Dark Cherries, and is about to take Taiyo back with him to Mutsumi, when he's suddenly summoned by the chairman of the Spy Association, Kai Izumo...
